title: Codebase Intelligence configuration
description: Configuration for the codebase-intelligence CLI, MCP server, and CI gate. Place in a file named codebase-intelligence.json (or .codebase-intelligence.json / .codebase-intelligencerc.json) at the project root.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON Schema, for editor autocomplete and validation.

root.description: Project root to analyze, relative to the config file.

include.description: Glob patterns of files to analyze. Defaults to all .ts/.tsx not ignored.

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from analysis (in addition to .gitignore, node_modules, .d.ts).

entry.description: Entry-point files or globs. Exports reachable from entries are never reported as dead. Framework conventions (Next.js routes, Convex functions, test files) are auto-detected on top of this.

dependencies.description: Package names never reported as unused/unlisted.

unresolvedImports.description: Import specifier patterns to treat as resolvable (e.g. virtual modules).

exportsUsedInFile.description: If true, an export referenced anywhere in its own file is not reported as dead.

rules.description: Rule configuration, ESLint-style. Each key is a rule id; the value is a severity ('off' | 'warn' | 'error' or 0 | 1 | 2), or a tuple [severity, options]. Unknown rule ids are validated against the generic entry shape so custom rules are allowed.

no-dead-exports.description: Report exported symbols that are never imported (respecting entry points + framework awareness).

no-dead-files.description: Report files unreachable from any entry point.

no-unused-deps.description: Report package.json dependencies that are never imported.

skipLocal.description: Only report clones that span different directories.

max-cyclomatic-complexity.description: Forbid functions above a cyclomatic-complexity threshold.

max-cognitive-complexity.description: Forbid functions above a cognitive-complexity threshold.

no-boundary-violations.description: Forbid imports that cross a forbidden architecture boundary (see top-level 'boundaries').

no-divergent-paths.description: Highways gate: forbid more than N divergent code paths for one logical data operation (low data-path reuse).

minRoutes.description: Flag an operation group with at least this many divergent routes.

maxConvergenceRatio.description: Flag only when shared-intermediate ratio is below this.

no-comments.description: Forbid comments. By default forbids // line comments while allowing JSDoc, compiler/tool directives, and a license header. Set style:'all' to forbid every comment.

style.description: Which comment kinds to forbid: 'line' (//), 'block' (/* */), or 'all'.

allowDirectives.description: Allow directive comments such as @ts-expect-error, @ts-ignore, eslint-disable, and this tool's own ci-ignore comments.

allowLicenseHeader.description: Allow a comment at the very top of a file (license/banner).

allow.description: Additional substrings/patterns whose comments are allowed (e.g. 'TODO', 'FIXME', '@public').

boundaries.description: Architecture boundary rules. Used by the no-boundary-violations rule.

preset.description: Start from a preset architecture, then override with zones/rules.

zones.description: Named logical areas of the codebase.

allow.description: Zone names this zone may import.

forbid.description: Zone names this zone may not import.

minScore.description: Fail if the 0-100 health score is below this.

output.description: Default output options (CLI flags override these).

baseline.description: Path to a baseline file. When set, the CI gate fails only on findings not present in the baseline.

gate.description: Fail on all findings, or only on findings introduced since --base.

failOn.description: Minimum severity that makes the process exit non-zero.

maxWarnings.description: Fail if warnings exceed this count. -1 disables the warning gate.

tolerance.description: Allowed percent growth in findings vs baseline before failing.

base.description: Git ref to diff against for new-only gating (e.g. origin/main). Overridable with --base.

ruleEntry.description: A rule severity, or a [severity, options] tuple.
